metadata.purpose: Static prototype emission factors for sources that do not carry their own factor lookup.
metadata.notes: SAP fuel factors live in sap_material_lookup.json because they are material-code specific. Production should move all factors into an EmissionFactor table with geography, effective dates, and source-version metadata.

us_grid_average_location_based.source_detail: EPA eGRID 2023 U.S. total output CO2e rate: 770.884 lb/MWh, converted to 0.3497 kg CO2e per kWh.
us_grid_average_location_based.prototype_use: Default location-based factor for utility_electricity_mock.csv when no utility/grid-region factor is supplied.
us_grid_average_location_based.caveat: This is a U.S. average location-based factor. Production must support eGRID subregion, supplier-specific factors, RECs, and PPAs.

flight_short_haul_economy_with_rf.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 Government GHG Conversion Factors
flight_short_haul_economy_with_rf.source_detail: Business travel- air > Flights > Short-haul, to/from UK > Economy class > With RF.
flight_short_haul_economy_with_rf.prototype_use: Default for short-haul economy flights such as EWR-BOS.

flight_long_haul_economy_with_rf.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 Government GHG Conversion Factors
flight_long_haul_economy_with_rf.source_detail: Business travel- air > Flights > Long-haul, to/from UK > Economy class > With RF.

flight_long_haul_business_with_rf.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 Government GHG Conversion Factors
flight_long_haul_business_with_rf.source_detail: Business travel- air > Flights > Long-haul, to/from UK > Business class > With RF.
flight_long_haul_business_with_rf.prototype_use: Default for long-haul business flights such as SFO-LHR.

hotel_uk_london.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 Government GHG Conversion Factors
hotel_uk_london.prototype_use: Default for London hotel room-night segments.

car_rental_petrol_medium.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 Government GHG Conversion Factors
car_rental_petrol_medium.source_detail: Passenger vehicles > Cars (by size) > Medium car > Petrol.
car_rental_petrol_medium.prototype_use: Default for intermediate petrol rental cars after applying the 50 km/day distance proxy.

rail_national.source: UK DEFRA/DESNZ 2024 Government GHG Conversion Factors
rail_national.source_detail: Business travel- land > Rail > National rail.
rail_national.prototype_use: Default rail factor when route-specific rail factors are unavailable.
